The Fluid Mosaic Model describes the cell membrane, not the cell wall.
The model explains the structure of the cell membrane.
The model does not describe the nucleus.
The model does not describe plastids.
The mesenteric artery carries oxygenated blood to the intestines.
The pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs.
The femoral artery carries oxygenated blood to the lower limb.
The celiac artery carries oxygenated blood to abdominal organs.
Villi are not found in the esophagus.
The stomach lining does not have intestinal villi.
Villi line the small intestine and increase its absorptive surface area.
The large intestine does not have the villi characteristic of the small intestine.
Glucose is a carbohydrate product, not the hydrogen source.
Carbon dioxide supplies carbon for carbohydrate formation, not hydrogen.
Ethanol is not the hydrogen source in photosynthesis.
Water supplies hydrogen used to reduce carbon compounds during photosynthesis.
Peptides are products of protein digestion, not the activated form of pepsinogen.
Pepsinogen is converted into the active enzyme pepsin.
Bicarbonates help neutralize acid but are not formed from pepsinogen.
Gastrin is a hormone, not the product of pepsinogen activation.
About 50–70 billion cells die each day in an adult human.

Anatomy studies body structures, not gene insertion into bacteria.
Physiology studies how organisms and their parts function.
Pharmacology studies drugs and their effects.
Using genetic engineering to insert a human gene into bacteria is biotechnology.
Louis Pasteur is known chiefly for work in microbiology and fermentation.
William Harvey is associated with describing blood circulation.
Ibn-e-Nafees is associated with describing pulmonary circulation.
Jabir-bin-Hayan is credited in the textbook with giving the concept of metabolism.
The saying is attributed to Dr. Abdus Salam, not Jabir-bin-Hayan.

Dr. Samar Mubarik is not the person associated with this quotation.
Dr. Abdul Qadeer Khan is not the person associated with this quotation.
Oscar Hertwig discovered meiosis in 1876 while studying sea urchin eggs.
Thomas Hunt Morgan is known for work on chromosome inheritance, not this discovery.
Hunt Morgan is not the scientist credited with discovering meiosis in 1876.
Walther Flemming studied cell division but is not credited with this discovery.
Hominidae is a family, not an order.
Chordates form a phylum, not the human order.
Humans belong to the order Primates.
Mammalia is a class, not an order.

Lactic acid is not the main product of lipid digestion.
Lipases break lipids into glycerol and fatty acids.
Ascorbic acid is vitamin C, not a product of lipid digestion.

A habitat is the place where organisms live, not the group itself.
A community includes populations of different species.
A population consists of members of the same species living in the same place at the same time.
Organisms are individual living things, not a group defined by species and place.
